corpus.text: Responsive layouts in Flutter can be built using LayoutBuilder, MediaQuery, or custom adaptive widgets to support mobile and desktop screens.
Flutter's rendering pipeline uses Widgets, Elements, and RenderObjects to draw the user interface on the screen.
State management libraries like Provider, Riverpod, or BLoC help separate UI presentation from business logic.
The local-first database architecture uses Isar for fast cross-platform persistent storage and relational graph queries.
The synchronization protocol implements client-side encryption and Last-Write-Wins (LWW) conflict resolution over WebSockets.
We combine Isar text search with ObjectBox vector search (HNSW) using a weighted scoring hybrid search formula.
To calculate cosine similarity in Dart, compute the dot product of two vectors and divide by the product of their magnitudes.
WordPieceTokenizer divides text into subwords, adding CLS and SEP tokens, using a pre-defined vocabulary mapping.
Implement the EmbeddingsAdapter interface to plug in custom models like Gemini, OpenAI, or local ONNX runtimes.
The forgetting mechanism applies exponential decay to memory nodes based on access frequency and last accessed timestamp.
Temporal queries retrieve nodes that were updated or accessed within a specific time window, sorting by timestamp.
Memory consolidation merges recent interaction logs into long-term structured memory nodes overnight.
